newsitem.title: USA: Quebecor to acquire Petty Co for US$65 mln.
newsitem.headline: Quebecor to acquire Petty Co for US$65 mln.

text.p: Quebecor Printing Inc said on Friday that it has entered a tentative deal to acquire Petty Co for US$65 million, including the assumption of debt.
Petty is a provider of direct marketing printing services with annual revenues of $125 million and 750 employees.

The deal is subject to a satisfactory completion of due diligence reviews, approval by the Board of Directors of Quebecor Printing, the execution of a definitive agreement and compliance with all regulatory requirements, Quebecor said.
Quebecor said the deal is expected to be completed in January.
